Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
      |   `-- Reorganize ownership around CanvasWorkspace/CanvasSession, MappingEditorCanvas, workspace tools, SourceWindowPanel and CanvasViewReceiver. Remove injected DiagramService; preserve semantic controller, selection, history and persistence ownership. Locate components before connecting their detail.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
      |   `-- Retain semantic grid containment and collision layout, but distinguish it from presentationScene/resolveDiagramView displayed bounds. Qualify the statement that folding never affects sizing.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
      |   `-- Separate immutable content/revision identity from DiagramNode placement and DiagramPresentation state; retain per-diagram source evidence. The existing content hierarchy still fits; attach presentation detail through explicit placement/presentation nodes.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [C] FloatingBox variants
      |   `-- Include code-panel projection content and distinguish retained ProjectedPane ownership from SourceWindowPanel rendering outside MappingEditorCanvas. Closing the source window collapses eligible panes rather than removing selections.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
      |   `-- Add SourceWindowPanel as an explicit consumer of selection-owned projections. Connect its source-navigation detail without assigning window geometry to grid layout.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
      |   `-- Replace DiagramService content writes with stored-revision operations. Preserve version guards and separate exec commits; distinguish revision/batch receivers that flush before acknowledgement from ordinary apply commands.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D] Controller edits / agent access
      |   `-- Add MappingPage dispatch branches for CanvasViews, projection, generation, bounded reads, requested revision exports and checkpoint publication. These extend the existing command boundary; attach each to its receiver or controller operation.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
      |   `-- Separate previously issued content revisions from checkpoint publication; history append is not the content-generation owner. Preserve history navigation, transfer coordination and portable revision bindings.
      |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
      |   `-- Replace the superseded single-service owner with explicit revision operations, runtime retention and generateDiagram orchestration. Show supplied/generated edits converging on submission and retention before controller publication; preserve immutable identity.
      |-- [2] Add: MappingEditorCanvas and CanvasRuntimeContext
      |   `-- Detail the overview's editor integration: MappingPage supplies CanvasSession; runtime consumers access controller, editor and derived alternative/panel models. This develops canvas ownership, not a separate document store; connect from MappingEditorCanvas and the derived display registry.
      |-- [2] Add: Focused canvas projection
      |   `-- Detail MappingPage.projectDiagrams: explicit or highlighted placements become a copied child with remapped content, edges, presentation highlights, layout provenance and a blank placeholder. Attach from projectDiagrams; show saveDocument publication and child-only projection navigation preserving unrelated sessions.
      `-- [2] Add: ProjectionLayoutPanel and geometry worker
          `-- Develop focused projection's projectionLayout component: presets, geometry-only worker requests, cancellation, membership validation and version-checked commits. Distinguish original spacing from compact separation constraints; this remains canvas layout detail.
  |-- Unified selection - state, gestures and WebSocket  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: CanvasSession
          `-- Add capturedSelection and PromptComposerCoordinator as SelectionState consumers, including selection-ID-bound automatic references versus manual references. Add SourceWindowPanel under independent panel lifetime. Preserve existing selection rules; callers alone do not establish changed gestures.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
      |   `-- Reorganize around context resolution, targeted revision import, template/pinned-reference resolution, generation or supplied submission, and in-place versus variant installation. Preserve deduplication, version checks, cancellation and acknowledgement retries; link authoring UI through an explicit request-composition component.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
      |   `-- Replace upload-only context assumptions with supported context sources and required edit-mode/replace-mode fields. Target, preconditions and request identity remain useful organizing branches.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
      |   `-- Add templates, pinned references, subtree/multi-scope targets, variant refinement and optional presentation promotion. Connect these fields to the overview's validation and reference-resolution steps.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
      |   `-- Add retained variant outputs, runtime session identity and next AgentContext. Context is returned after successful installation; retries reuse retained outputs. These fit the existing captured-input, execution and output branches.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
      |   `-- Replace fixed edit-input assumptions with resolved template/options, pinned reference text and scoped DiagramGenerator input. Preserve history isolation and runtime lifecycle responsibilities.
      `-- [1b] Extend: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
          `-- Add revision-review records and optional promoted alternatives beside direct installation. Attach from the overview's variant branch; retaining a candidate does not itself rebind live content.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
      |   `-- Remove the fixed twelve-tool assumption. Distinguish bounded current reads, requested revision exports and checkpoint publication from full-history compatibility paths; preserve the interface grouping.
      |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
      |   `-- Add evidenced create/extend capabilities, CanvasView/projection/generation commands, revision batches and diagram-context operations. Include workspace export/import-context preparation; keep browser bridge commands distinct from public tools and HTTP routes.
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
      |   `-- Replace RevisionedDiagramService injection with DiagramGenerator orchestration and explicit retention. Correct publication to checkpoint capture, persistence flush and acknowledgement; the execution/read/publication grouping remains accurate.
      `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Locate GenerationCanvasBridge, CanvasApiProjection and AgentChatService/ChatDiagramTools at their evidenced integration boundaries. Add context-library and diagram-context dependencies; connect to authoring detail rather than duplicating it.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: PersistentLayer
      |   `-- Update publication callers: MappingPage flushes workspace records and publishes a checkpoint reference with version guards. Retain full-history creation/compatibility callers and autosave versus catalog-publication separation; the storage organization still fits.
      `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
          `-- Add focused-projection saveDocument and context-aware workspace import/export callers under workspace persistence. Keep SearchArtifact explicitly proposed: the supplied search code establishes an in-memory worker index, not durable search artifacts.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: [MODEL] ChangeSession ownership
      |   `-- Remove the obsolete DiagramService dependency description while preserving proposal history, receipts and acceptance boundaries. Keep this correction at the evidenced integration boundary.
      `-- [1b] Extend: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
          `-- Add ChangeTreemapContent and DiffTreePanel navigation under REVIEW alongside ChangeSessionPreview. Attach the explicit ChangeTreemapContent node to treemap detail; retain the existing diff-rendering diagram rather than duplicating it.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
      |   `-- Distinguish ordinary incremental autosave, full transfer replacement and focused-projection saveDocument publication. Preserve the established record pipeline; projection publication retains unrelated sessions.
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Add CanvasViewReceiver and revision/batch/context receivers as flush-before-acknowledgement callers. Show checkpoint publication after flush/version recheck and context-aware export/import as separate operations attached to their actual callers.
  |-- C07: Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw), Projection  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: [P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
      |   `-- Replace deferred rendering in Proposal 3 with implemented DiagramAlternativeControls and DiagramSidePanelContent. Preserve pinned parts, placement-specific choices and unchanged bound content; no lifecycle redraw is needed.
      `-- [1b] Extend: [P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
          `-- Add explicit select/open-panel consumers and connect to rendering detail in Central and side diagrams - Attempt 2. Preserve the already accurate immutable revision and review diagrams without duplicating their detail.
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
          `-- Add MappingPage's CanvasViewReceiver ownership, CanvasViewControls command submission and controller/persistence boundary. Show pane/camera capture and CanvasViewDiffPreview separately from saved endpoints. Caller evidence supports this integration extension, not replacement of existing branching semantics.
  |-- Central and side diagrams - Attempt 2  existing canvas
      |-- [1b] Extend: DIAGRAM REVISIONS + PRESENTATION CHOICES
      |   `-- Locate canvasDisplayNodes, DiagramAlternativeControls and DiagramSidePanelContent as derived presentation consumers. Preserve the distinction between display choices and review application; add explicit component nodes before linking detail.
      `-- [2] Add: Alternative controls and side-panel rendering
          `-- Develop the overview's ROW PROJECTION and controls/panel components: logical-ref folding, source rows/provenance, inline swapping, panel focus/open/close, part switching and regular/diff plus flow/overlay controls. Mutations return through the controller; this is the canvas's established presentation subject.
  |-- C12: Roll-up 1, g2, Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
      |   `-- Replace obsolete service ownership with workspace/session, editor, tools and source-window boundaries. Preserve accurate history/selection branches and connect existing [R], [P1] and [P2] components; added summaries do not repair the old overview.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
      |   `-- Separate semantic layout from presentation-aware displayed bounds while retaining containment and collision responsibilities.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
      |   `-- Align immutable content and placement presentation with existing [R] and [P1]; preserve source evidence ownership. The content hierarchy still fits.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [C] FloatingBox variants
      |   `-- Include code-panel projections and explicitly locate SourceWindowPanel as their external renderer. Retain projection ownership and link to source-window detail rather than duplicating it.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
      |   `-- Replace service-based writes with stored-revision operations; distinguish bounded capture and flush-before-acknowledgement paths. Preserve exec commit semantics and link expanded commands to canonical detail.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
      |   `-- Separate content issuance from checkpoint recording; connect existing [R]'s publication boundary. Preserve navigation and coordinated transfers.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Replace the superseded service owner with revision operations, runtime retention and generation orchestration. Reuse [R] for lifecycle detail; do not duplicate its accurate representation.
  |-- C14: Roll-up 2, g2, Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
      |   `-- Reorganize around workspace/session, MappingEditorCanvas and tool/source windows. Preserve accurate branches and attach existing [R] and [P] summaries; the obsolete ownership overview itself needs replacement.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
      |   `-- Qualify displayed sizing through presentation-aware projection without replacing semantic grid-layout responsibilities.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
      |   `-- Align immutable content and placement presentation with [R] and [P]; retain per-diagram source bindings and captured evidence.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [C] FloatingBox variants
      |   `-- Include code-panel content and SourceWindowPanel rendering. Keep retained projection ownership distinct from window placement and connect shared source-window detail.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
      |   `-- Update content-write and capture boundaries, preserve operation-batch/exec semantics, and connect expanded commands to canonical detail. The existing command organization remains useful.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
      |   `-- Remove content issuance from history ownership and connect checkpoint publication to [R]; preserve history navigation and transfer coordination.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Replace the obsolete service boundary with explicit operations, retention and generation. Keep [R] and [P] as accurate supporting detail rather than adding duplicates.
  |-- [3] Prompt composition and authoring  new canvas
      |-- PromptComposer ownership and request lifecycle
      |   `-- MappingPage owns PromptComposerCoordinator; entries own targets, drafts, panel conversation identity, exact requests and polling. Panel closure does not discard entries or cancel generation. Explain this distinct UI lifecycle rather than broadening the AgentContext conversion canvas.
      |-- Templates, selections and pinned references
      |   `-- Attach from the overview's draft/reference components. Show ordered template/text/reference blocks, automatic selection bindings versus manual references, revision lookup and copying/insertion. Distinguish inserting a pinned reference from placing new content on the canvas.
      |-- Create, update, extend and variant review
      |   `-- Attach from the coordinator's submit and VariantReview components. Show operation-specific capture/validation, subtree updates, extension anchors/origin and explicit review application. Connect to existing review-domain detail instead of duplicating its merge algorithm.
      `-- Connect from MappingPage's PromptComposerCoordinator and the AgentContext edit overview's request-composition component; the new canvas owns authoring detail, not revision storage or editor state.
  |-- [3] Source windows and repository navigation  new canvas
      |-- SourceWindowPanel ownership and projection selection
      |   `-- MappingPage mounts a per-document consumer of retained selection/projection state. Visible expanded source-code/code-panel projections are eligible; focused code-panel wins, otherwise the last eligible pane is shown. Distinguish WindowPanel state from retained display records.
      |-- Source preloading and navigation
      |   `-- Attach from SourceWindowPanel's codeRepo and SourceCodePane components. Show active-document preloading with range-derived versions, explicit reload, file browsing, back/forward visits, scroll state and cancellable definition requests. Keep SessionCodePanel as the alternate renderer without inventing internals.
      |-- Source freshness and presentation
      |   `-- Attach from SourceCodePane's loaded-file comparison: hash mismatch keeps current source visible but disables mapped highlights and compaction folds. Explain the independent source read/navigation lifecycle, which needs an overview beyond canvas geometry.
      `-- Connect from MappingPage's SourceWindowPanel and [C] FloatingBox variants' ProjectedPane consumer; preserve selection ownership in the existing canvas.
  `-- [3] Canvas and change treemaps  new canvas
      |-- Treemap ownership and navigation overview
      |   `-- MappingPage selects CanvasTreemapContent or ChangeTreemapContent in workspace tools; both feed TreemapContent and publish tint/navigation callbacks. This shared metric subsystem needs its own overview rather than broadening search or persistence.
      |-- Canvas source coverage
      |   `-- Attach from CanvasTreemapContent. Inspect actual placements including folded diagrams; distinguish repository/corpus/path line universes, read files and validate captured ranges. Allocate overlapping LOC across distinct owners; show mapped-range/file scopes and excluded-source issues.
      |-- Change-hunk allocation
      |   `-- Attach from ChangeTreemapContent. Count additions/deletions from captured hunks, resolve inherited DiffTree destinations, split shared hunks equally and retain Unmapped coverage. Distinguish raw and allocated totals, previous-revision destinations and non-text changes with no LOC area.
      |-- Treemap layout and canvas interaction
      |   `-- Attach from TreemapContent's layout/color consumers. Show deterministic area-preserving partitions and observational region hit-testing without intercepting pan, source links or controls. Attach version-aware polling and terminal-session stopping to ChangeTreemapContent.
      `-- Connect from MappingPage's Treemaps component and ChangeSession operations' ChangeTreemapContent node; keep derived metrics separate from document mutation and saved search artifacts.
